confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from a few searches: some sources are undated or from 2021-2024, the wine figure rests on a single review, and yen prices were converted at an approximate rate. Cocktail and wine anchors use the beer-based price relationship, since direct evidence is weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and July peak-season context (Gion Matsuri), not from live listings. The FX observation is dated 2026-03-20 and was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not confirm it against the page or verify that it is the latest observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Japanese national and Tokyo/Osaka benchmarks, adjusted toward Kyoto-specific izakaya, cafe, and hotel-bar listings. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a tourist-heavy Japanese city in July.
